title: Fix Rust unresolved import — use exact crate name
description: When Rust says unresolved import, use the exact crate name from Cargo.toml. Never append _lib suffix.
problem_statement: Rust compiler says unresolved import for a crate that exists in Cargo.toml.
curator_notes: Common pattern from Rust dogfood slices. The model frequently appends _lib to crate names.
